definitionZh: @property CSS at-rule 用于明确定义 CSS 自定义属性,允许属性类型检查和约束,设定默认值,并确定自定义属性是否可以继承值.
sourceDefinition: The @property CSS at-rule is used to explicitly define CSS custom properties, allowing for property type checking and constraining, setting default values, and defining whether a custom property can inherit values or not.
